schemes.official_name: Students as Change Agents (EFIE08003) / EFI Change Agents (EFIE08006)
schemes.description: Credit-bearing 20-credit pass/fail undergraduate course. Small interdisciplinary student teams explore a challenge proposed by an external partner (non-profit, public or private), meet fortnightly with group coaches, negotiate the problem statement with the partner, and produce a team output (business-style report, process map or prototype with implementation plan) that is presented/sent to the partner, plus an individual 1000-word reflection.
schemes.eligible_faculties_programmes: Conflicting: the 2025/26 EFI catalogue lists EFIE08003 with availability code SV1 (all students incl. visiting) and the careers page says the elective is for 1st/2nd-year students; the 2024/25 EFIE08006 entry restricts the course to students on the EFI Interdisciplinary Futures (MA) degree.

schemes.credit_assessment: 20 SCQF credits; pass/fail; group output (one submission, same result for all) plus individual 1000-word reflection; both must be passed
schemes.delivery_format: Interdisciplinary teams with group coaches; partner presents challenge at start
schemes.project_evidence: Team explores a partner-proposed challenge and produces outputs and recommendations (src 2, 3).
schemes.group_evidence: 'Work in a small team'; one submission for the whole group with the same result for all members (src 2, 3).
schemes.employer_evidence: External partner proposes the challenge, attends/presents early on, teams negotiate the problem statement with them, and the group output goes to the partner in writing and as a presentation (src 2, 3). Careers page lists partner examples from non-profit, public and private sectors (src 1).
schemes.partner_role: Sets the challenge, gives context at start, receives output/presentation
schemes.deliverable: Team report/process map/prototype with implementation plan presented to partner; individual reflection
schemes.unresolved: University-wide eligibility vs MA Interdisciplinary Futures-only is unresolved (search summaries; EFIE08003 and EFIE08006 may be the same course renamed). Participant numbers not found.

profile_md:
**Edinburgh** has no institution-wide employer-project programme in operation. The one university-wide scheme, Students as Change Agents (SACHA), survives only as a 20-credit EFI course (EFIE08003 / EFIE08006) in which small interdisciplinary teams work on a challenge set by an external partner and present outputs to it; the Careers co-curricular route is paused. Whether the elective is open university-wide or restricted to the EFI Interdisciplinary Futures MA is unresolved.

The densest provision is distributed in the **Business School**: live-client team consultancies for MSc Global Strategy and Sustainability (teams of 5-6, ten weeks, current in the 2026/27 catalogue), MSc Entrepreneurship and Innovation, MSc Climate Change Finance and Investment, the MBA (consultancy project and a one-week charity consultancy), and an undergraduate Enterprise Consultancy Project (2025/26) for a new local business. Clients propose challenges, attend scoping and presentations, and receive reports; several of these pages are undated or last evidenced before 2025.

**EFI** MSc Creative Industries has a compulsory Client Consulting Project (cultural-organisation client, 2025/26) and a Team Project that mixes client-led and student-led work. The Law School's LLM Human Rights Clinic produces group research with Together for Scottish Government audiences. Design with Data (Design Informatics) is group-based and may use an external organisation's data but partner role is not documented.

Mostly postgraduate and programme-bound; undergraduate access is limited to the Enterprise Consultancy Project and the EFI elective.
